# Validate a page by hand

Read the page and check each field yourself.
template:
# The house how-to: the built-in, minus tgdp-one-method, plus a regex eval of
# its own and the config's no-todo-markers.
templates:
  how-to:
    extends: tgdp:how-to:1.6
    types: [how-to]
    evals:
      - use: tgdp-one-method
        skip: true
      - id: shows-the-command
        assertion: The page shows the manni command it is about.
        grader: tool:regex
        options:
          pattern: "manni [a-z]+"
          match: contains
      - use: no-todo-markers
